We have an agenda that Dr. Stone would have prepared, and Dr. Stone is our program director. Dr. Stone, he is away and he'll actually probably is traveling back tomorrow. But, you know, it is sad he had to go all the way to Hawaii and, you know, to present. I wonder if he presented the whole time. I bet you he had a vacation while he was there, too. We've we've learned a lot over the last semester. So life should be a lot, lot better for you this semester because it's not we're not going to have to be creating things by the seat of our bridges sometime. We've got a lot of good stuff established for you. And it's going to be a great semester. And I'm glad that you have that you've chosen to embrace this opportunity to become a 21st century school administrator. And, you know, I'm just excited to be a part of this next step in your life. Dr. Revis. Well, good evening. I love teaching this first course. """
